cues.en: Instructor: Continuing our discovery of different types of regression analyses.
cues.zh: 講師：繼續探索不同類型的迴歸分析。

cues.en: This video is going to be all about logistic regression.
cues.zh: 這支影片專門介紹邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: I will start by explaining what that term means and describing how a logistic regression differs from like the normal regression that we've been working with so far.
cues.zh: 先解釋這個詞的意義，以及它與目前使用的一般迴歸有什麼差別。

cues.en: How to compute a logistic regression.
cues.zh: 如何計算邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: And also I will show you an example so you can see how to work with the outputs of a logistic regression.
cues.zh: 也會舉例，示範如何使用邏輯斯迴歸的輸出。

cues.en: So a logistic regression also sometimes called binary logistic regression has a dependent variable that is logical or Boolean.
cues.zh: 邏輯斯迴歸，有時也稱二元邏輯斯迴歸，其依變數是邏輯或布林值。

cues.en: That's where this name comes from.
cues.zh: 名稱由此而來。

cues.en: Logistic doesn't mean logistics like you know, figuring out how to get a package from one part of the world to another part of the world.
cues.zh: Logistic 不是物流，不是研究如何把包裹從世界一端送到另一端。

cues.en: This is about logical variables.
cues.zh: 這裡談的是邏輯變數。

cues.en: So some examples are true or false, male or female.
cues.zh: 例如真或假、男性或女性。

cues.en: This is a clinical environment.
cues.zh: 如果在臨床情境，

cues.en: We say there is a tumor or there isn't a tumor, or yeah, if it's like a game or something, then you win or lose for an exam, you pass or fail, any kind of situation where the dependent variable
cues.zh: 有腫瘤或沒有腫瘤；遊戲則是勝或敗；考試是及格或不及格。只要依變數

cues.en: is binary, it only takes one of two answers, then that is where you would use a logistic regression.
cues.zh: 是二元，只取兩個答案之一，就會使用邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: And then just a quick note, you can extend a logistic, a binary logistic regression to any number of categorical outcomes.
cues.zh: 快速補充，可以把二元邏輯斯迴歸，延伸到任意數量的類別結果。

cues.en: In that case, it's called a multinomial logistic regression.
cues.zh: 那就稱為多項邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: Multinomial logistic regression is basically what deep neural networks are implementing for image recognition, for example, and categorization.
cues.zh: 例如深度神經網路進行影像辨識與分類，基本上就在實作多項邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: So they have discreet categorical events and there's more than two of 'em.
cues.zh: 有離散類別事件，而且超過兩類。

cues.en: So that's multinomial.
cues.zh: 所以稱為多項。

cues.en: But for now we're just gonna be talking about binary logistic regression.
cues.zh: 目前先只談二元邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: Now one thing to keep in mind before we get too much further is that a logistic regression does not actually classify.
cues.zh: 深入之前，要記住，邏輯斯迴歸本身不會真正分類。

cues.en: So the output of a logistic regression is not going to be true or false.
cues.zh: 輸出不是「真」或「假」。

cues.en: It's not going to be pass or fail.
cues.zh: 也不是「及格」或「不及格」。

cues.en: Instead, a logistic regression is going to return probabilities of different events occurring.
cues.zh: 而是回傳不同事件發生的機率。

cues.en: So we will get a probability of passing or failing.
cues.zh: 會得到及格或不及格的機率。

cues.en: And then after the logistic regression analysis is done, then we as the researchers, as the data scientists, the statisticians, we can do classification
cues.zh: 邏輯斯迴歸分析完成後，我們作為研究者、資料科學家、統計學家，才能透過

cues.en: by implementing some kind of a threshold.
cues.zh: 某種門檻來分類。

cues.en: For example, if the regression says that the probability is greater than 0.5, then we can consider that to be a classification guess of true.
cues.zh: 例如，迴歸說機率大於 0.5，就把分類猜測視為「真」。

cues.en: So you'll see exactly this later on in the video when I show you an example.
cues.zh: 影片稍後的例子，會清楚看到。

cues.en: Alright, so here is how we set up the logistic regression.
cues.zh: 這是邏輯斯迴歸的設定方式。

cues.en: Now, the right hand side of this equation is exactly a normal vanilla run of the mill everyday regression.
cues.zh: 方程式右側，就是非常一般、普通的迴歸。

cues.en: It's exactly what you've been seeing now for the past, I don't know, dozen videos or something.
cues.zh: 與過去十幾支影片看到的相同。

cues.en: So this is nothing new here.
cues.zh: 沒有新東西。

cues.en: What's new is how we set up the left hand side of this equation.
cues.zh: 新的是方程式左側。

cues.en: So we say that it's the natural log of the ratio of the probability of an event happening to the probability of that event not happening.
cues.zh: 對事件發生機率，除以不發生機率的比值，取自然對數。

cues.en: Now this ratio should look familiar, P over one minus P.
cues.zh: 這個 P 除以 1 減 P 的比值，應該很熟悉。

cues.en: This is the odds ratio that you learned about in the section on probability theory.
cues.zh: 是機率論單元學過的勝算比。

cues.en: So we are computing the odds of an event occurring versus not occurring.
cues.zh: 計算的是事件發生相對於不發生的勝算。

cues.en: So P over one minus P.
cues.zh: P 除以 1 減 P。

cues.en: Now I'm going to show you in the next slide why the natural log is used.
cues.zh: 下一張投影片會解釋，為什麼用自然對數。

cues.en: So why we don't just compute the ratio of P over one minus P.
cues.zh: 為什麼不只計算 P 除以 1 減 P。

cues.en: So for now, for this slide, just assume that that this is fine.
cues.zh: 這張先假設這樣沒問題。

cues.en: And then in the next slide I will show you a graph that will explain why the natural log is really handy here.
cues.zh: 下一張會有圖，說明自然對數為什麼方便。

cues.en: Okay, so the problem is that we don't wanna solve for the log of P over one minus P, we wanna solve for P, we wanna know the actual probability.
cues.zh: 問題是，我們不想解出 log(P/(1−P))，而是想解出 P，知道實際機率。

cues.en: So what we need to do is a little bit of algebra to solve for P.
cues.zh: 所以需要一點代數，求解 P。

cues.en: So in a moment I'm gonna ask you to pause the video, bust out a piece of paper and a pencil, and work through this problem by hand.
cues.zh: 稍後會請你暫停影片，拿紙筆，手動解題。

cues.en: So solve for P.
cues.zh: 解出 P。

cues.en: Now I'm going to give two hints.
cues.zh: 會給兩個提示。

cues.en: One hint is not really such a great hint, and the other hint is so amazing that it's kind of like cheating.
cues.zh: 一個提示不算好，另一個好到幾乎像作弊。

cues.en: So if you don't want any hints you want to solve for p on your own, now is the time to pause the video.
cues.zh: 如果不想看提示，想自己解，現在暫停。

cues.en: Okay, so now I'm going to give you the first hint, which doesn't really solve the problem, it just kind of makes it a little bit easier to work with.
cues.zh: 第一個提示不會真正解題，只是讓運算比較容易。

cues.en: So the first hint is to take all of this stuff here, the entire model, and just call it p sorry, y hat.
cues.zh: 把這整個模型，稱為 P——抱歉，是 yHat。

cues.en: Call us y hat.
cues.zh: 稱為 yHat。

cues.en: So set y hat equal to beta zero plus beta one, x one, blah, blah, blah, blah.
cues.zh: 令 yHat 等於 beta0 加 beta1 x1，依此類推。

cues.en: So that doesn't really help you solve the problem, but it does, sort of make things a little bit decluttered, it simplifies things a little bit.
cues.zh: 不真正幫你解題，但減少雜亂，稍微簡化。

cues.en: Okay? So if that's the hint you wanted, then now you can pause the video again.
cues.zh: 如果只需要這個提示，現在可以再暫停。

cues.en: And if you want the second hint, then here it is.
cues.zh: 如果要第二個提示，就是這個。

cues.en: The second hint is to go back to towards the beginning of the course, the section on math prerequisites.
cues.zh: 回到課程前段，數學先備知識單元。

cues.en: And in particular look for the video on the logistic function and a solving logistic function.
cues.zh: 找邏輯斯函數，以及解邏輯斯函數的影片。

cues.en: And if you watch that video, that's gonna tell you exactly how to solve this problem.
cues.zh: 看那支影片，就會知道這題的確切解法。

cues.en: Okay, so now I'm not gonna walk through the entire mechanism of solving for P and that's because I did it in that video in the logistic equation video.
cues.zh: 我不會逐步走過求 P 的全部過程，因為邏輯斯方程式那支影片已經做過。

cues.en: So, but I will say a few things quickly.
cues.zh: 不過快速說幾點。

cues.en: So the where you start with is by taking both sides to the natural exponent.
cues.zh: 首先，把兩側都取自然指數。

cues.en: So you say E to the, this stuff equals E to the this stuff.
cues.zh: 也就是 e 的這個次方，等於 e 的那個次方。

cues.en: So E in log and natural log are inverses of each other.
cues.zh: e 的指數與自然對數互為反運算。

cues.en: So that gets rid of the log over here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡的對數消掉。

cues.en: And then we have E to the model prediction.
cues.zh: 另一邊有 e 的模型預測值次方。

cues.en: This is all Y hat here.
cues.zh: 這全部是 yHat。

cues.en: This is, you can just think of this as one variable, which is y hat.
cues.zh: 可以把它看成一個變數 yHat。

cues.en: Okay? And then you have to do a little bit of fancy stuff, little bit of finagling with the algebra to solve for P here.
cues.zh: 接著需要一些代數技巧，稍微整理，才能解出 P。

cues.en: But you can imagine it starts by multiplying both sides by one minus P.
cues.zh: 可以想像，先兩側乘上 1 減 P。

cues.en: And then you can find that you can basically regroup this, the right hand side of this equation to get P as one variable.
cues.zh: 再重新整理方程式右側，讓 P 成為一個變數，

cues.en: And then you have E to the this thing as the other variable.
cues.zh: 而 e 的這個次方，成為另一個變數。

cues.en: And then you have to divide.
cues.zh: 接著做除法。

cues.en: So you end up with the probability equals one divided by one plus E to the minus yhat.
cues.zh: 最後機率等於 1 除以 1 加 e 的負 yHat 次方。

cues.en: And all this stuff is yhat.
cues.zh: 這些全部是 yHat。

cues.en: This is just the model prediction here.
cues.zh: 就是模型預測。

cues.en: So that's how we solve for a logistic equation.
cues.zh: 這就是解邏輯斯方程式的方式。

cues.en: Now, I just wanna say a quick word about the log function.
cues.zh: 快速談一下對數函數。

cues.en: Here, what you see is in blue, this is the odds ratio.
cues.zh: 藍色是勝算比。

cues.en: So P divided by one minus P, and here in green, this green line shows the log of that.
cues.zh: P 除以 1 減 P，綠線則顯示它的對數。

cues.en: So the natural log of P divided by one minus P.
cues.zh: 也就是 log(P/(1−P))。

cues.en: So you can see that the odds ratio at this scale looks like basically a flat line.
cues.zh: 在這個尺度，勝算比看起來幾乎像平線。

cues.en: It's hard to even see that it's changing here, whereas the log of that ratio is really, has a really large dynamic range.
cues.zh: 很難看出變化，但這個比值的對數，有很大的動態範圍。

cues.en: And this is the main reason why we choose to use the log here.
cues.zh: 這是使用對數的主要原因。

cues.en: So the point is that when we get to small values, small probability values, the logs of those small values have a really large dynamic range.
cues.zh: 機率很小時，小數值的對數具有很大的動態範圍。

cues.en: And that is easier to work with in optimization problems.
cues.zh: 最佳化問題比較容易處理。

cues.en: And this is fundamentally an optimization problem.
cues.zh: 這本質上就是最佳化問題。

cues.en: So we increase the dynamic range that helps the model find the right parameters to make the model best fit the data.
cues.zh: 增加動態範圍，有助模型找到正確參數，讓模型最佳擬合資料。

cues.en: And that's why we use the logarithm here.
cues.zh: 所以用對數。

cues.en: Okay, so how do we find these beta coefficients here?
cues.zh: 如何找到 beta 係數？

cues.en: What do you think?
cues.zh: 你覺得呢？

cues.en: Well, it turns out that there are non-linearities here.
cues.zh: 這裡有非線性。

cues.en: So look, we have beta coefficients in the exponential, and then there's a division here.
cues.zh: beta 係數放在指數裡，這裡又有除法。

cues.en: This is wrong, it's all terrible.
cues.zh: 這不對，全都糟透了。

cues.en: Remember I said in the beginning of this section that the general linear model means we have to have linear coefficients.
cues.zh: 記得本單元開頭說，一般線性模型必須有線性係數。

cues.en: So the coefficients are only allowed to add and scale or multiply.
cues.zh: 係數只允許相加、縮放，也就是相乘。

cues.en: So this is illegal in the context of the general linear model.
cues.zh: 所以在一般線性模型中，這是不允許的。

cues.en: So that means that it is not possible to use the closed form solution that's given to us by linear algebra, which is what I'm calling here, the left inverse.
cues.zh: 不能使用線性代數提供的封閉形式解，也就是這裡稱為左反矩陣的方式。

cues.en: That's the math solution to the general linear model that I showed you in the beginning of this section.
cues.zh: 那是本單元開頭展示的一般線性模型數學解。

cues.en: So that's not possible.
cues.zh: 所以這裡不可行。

cues.en: That doesn't mean we can't fit the model, it just means we cannot fit the model using the standard left inverse linear approach.
cues.zh: 不是不能擬合模型，而是不能用標準左反矩陣的線性方法擬合。

cues.en: So instead what we do is use iterative methods and the dominant one, the one that's used most often is gradient descent.
cues.zh: 改用迭代方法，最主要、最常用的是梯度下降。

cues.en: There's different varieties of of gradient descent, but we use a gradient descent algorithm to find the set of parameters, the beta coefficients that make these probabilities,
cues.zh: 梯度下降有不同變體，用它尋找一組 beta 參數，讓這些機率，

cues.en: the output best match the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 也就是輸出，最符合依變數。

cues.en: So basically the way that works is we start off with some random betas.
cues.zh: 基本上，先從一些隨機 beta 開始。

cues.en: So we plug in these random betas and we see how well does this equation then produce probabilities
cues.zh: 代入隨機 beta，看看方程式產生的機率，

cues.en: that match the dependent variable, the binary dependent variable.
cues.zh: 與二元依變數符合得如何。

cues.en: And then with random numbers, it's not going to fit it very well.
cues.zh: 隨機數當然不會擬合得很好。

cues.en: So then we pick new random numbers and we kind of tweak all of these beta parameters and carve out this landscape until we eventually find a good
cues.zh: 接著選新隨機數，稍微調整 beta 參數，在地形中探索，直到找到一組好的

cues.en: set of beta parameters, a good set of weights that make this equation fit the observed
cues.zh: beta 參數、權重，讓這個方程式能相當良好地擬合觀察到的

cues.en: binary data pretty well.
cues.zh: 二元資料。

cues.en: Okay, so that's the idea of gradient descent.
cues.zh: 這是梯度下降的概念。

cues.en: Now a full mathematical discussion of gradient descent is a bit beyond the scope of this course.
cues.zh: 完整數學討論，超過這門課的範圍。

cues.en: That's something you would learn about in a sort dedicated course on the kind of mathematical underpinnings of deep neural networks.
cues.zh: 那會在專門介紹深度神經網路數學基礎的課程中學到。

cues.en: So, but I hope that this explanation is sufficient.
cues.zh: 希望這樣的說明足夠。

cues.en: Essentially we just kind of pick random betas and then we keep looping through over and over again until the betas get closer and closer to a good solution
cues.zh: 基本上，先選隨機 beta，再反覆迴圈，直到 beta 愈來愈接近能符合

cues.en: to match the observed data.
cues.zh: 觀察資料的好解。

cues.en: What I'd like to do now is walk through an example application of a logistic regression.
cues.zh: 現在帶你看邏輯斯迴歸的應用例子。

cues.en: This will help you get the idea of what kind of dataset requires a logistic regression, how to interpret the results, and how to do classification
cues.zh: 幫助了解什麼資料需要它、如何解讀結果，以及如何用邏輯斯迴歸

cues.en: and categorization with logistic regression.
cues.zh: 進行分類。

cues.en: So this is pretty similar to the example we used before.
cues.zh: 與之前例子相當類似。

cues.en: So how does the amount of sleep and the number of study hours predict the score on an exam?
cues.zh: 睡眠量與讀書時數，如何預測考試分數？

cues.en: Except now we're just changing the deep end and variable slightly.
cues.zh: 只是稍微改變依變數。

cues.en: So now instead of trying to predict the exact score that people get on an exam, we just wanna predict whether they're going to pass the exam or fail.
cues.zh: 不預測精確考試分數，只預測及格或不及格。

cues.en: So here's what we do.
cues.zh: 做法如下。

cues.en: We ask a bunch of students, 20 students, and equals 20 to report the number of hours they slept and the number of hours they studied for the exam,
cues.zh: 請 20 位學生，N 等於 20，回報睡眠時數與準備考試的讀書時數，

cues.en: and then after the exam, okay, so then after the exam, we hack into the university secure network, find those students' records, steal their grades, but of course we are very interested in privacy.
cues.zh: 考完之後，駭入大學安全網路，找到學生紀錄、偷取成績；當然，我們很重視隱私。

cues.en: So then we label the grade as pass or fail instead of reporting the actual score, which could easily be traced back to the student's identity
cues.zh: 所以不報告容易追溯到學生身分的實際分數，而是把成績標成及格或不及格，

cues.en: because we are very concerned about privacy here.
cues.zh: 因為我們非常重視隱私。

cues.en: So here you see the data, we have 10 students who failed the exam and 10 students who passed the exam.
cues.zh: 這裡資料有 10 位不及格、10 位及格。

cues.en: So here you see on the Y axis is the number of hours, and in blue is the number of hours for studying, and in green is the number of hours that they slept.
cues.zh: Y 軸是時數，藍色讀書時數，綠色睡眠時數。

cues.en: So it looks like for sleep sleeping, there's a pretty, it certainly seems like there's a shift on the y axis for students who passed versus students who failed
cues.zh: 睡眠方面，及格與不及格學生在 Y 軸上，似乎確實有明顯位移，

cues.en: and for the number of hours spent studying, it doesn't really, yeah, well we'll have to see what the statistics show, but it doesn't look so obvious at least that there's going to be a significant effect of number
cues.zh: 讀書時數就沒那麼明顯，還是要看統計，但至少不太明顯看出會有顯著的讀書時數

cues.en: of hours spent studying.
cues.zh: 效果。

cues.en: Okay, so I ran this through a logistic regression.
cues.zh: 我對資料執行邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: We have two predictors.
cues.zh: 有兩個預測變數。

cues.en: I didn't include an interaction term.
cues.zh: 沒有納入交互作用項。

cues.en: So just these two predictors.
cues.zh: 只有這兩個預測變數。

cues.en: And the outcome variable, the dependent variable was binary fail, which was marked as a zero and pass, which is marked as a one.
cues.zh: 依變數是二元結果，不及格標 0，及格標 1。

cues.en: So here you see the results.
cues.zh: 這是結果。

cues.en: This is the regression table.
cues.zh: 這是迴歸表。

cues.en: Again, we have an intercept that the model includes, but particularly for a logistic regression, the intercept really often doesn't make sense.
cues.zh: 同樣包含截距，尤其邏輯斯迴歸，截距通常不太有意義。

cues.en: So it's in there because we need it to fit the model, but we usually don't even bother interpreting it.
cues.zh: 它存在是因為擬合需要，但通常甚至不費事解讀。

cues.en: Okay, so then we have the beta coefficient for study hours and the beta coefficient for sleep hours.
cues.zh: 接著有讀書時數與睡眠時數的 beta 係數。

cues.en: Now this is the unstandardized beta coefficient.
cues.zh: 這是未標準化係數。

cues.en: So immediately there should be alarm bells ringing in your head that are warning you not to compare these two different beta coefficients, because they're unstandardized.
cues.zh: 腦中應立刻響起警鈴，提醒不要比較不同 beta，因為沒有標準化。

cues.en: That's the first thing you should ever think of when you see unstandardized beta coefficients is not comparing them across different coefficients.
cues.zh: 看到未標準化係數，首先就該想到不要跨不同係數比較。

cues.en: However, it turns out in this case, we actually can directly compare these because they happen to be both in exactly the same scale.
cues.zh: 不過，這裡剛好可以直接比較，因為兩者恰好是完全相同尺度。

cues.en: So they're both in the same scale.
cues.zh: 兩者尺度相同。

cues.en: So we actually could compare these.
cues.zh: 所以實際上能比較。

cues.en: So then you see it's pretty clear that the effect of sleep is like an order of magnitude larger than the effect of studying.
cues.zh: 很清楚，睡眠效果比讀書大一個數量級左右。

cues.en: And in fact, when we look at the P values here, we see that that sleep is a significant predictor of exam success.
cues.zh: P 值也顯示，睡眠是考試成功的顯著預測變數。

cues.en: And study hours is not even remotely close to a significant predictor.
cues.zh: 讀書時數則離顯著預測變數還很遠。

cues.en: So what does that mean though?
cues.zh: 代表什麼？

cues.en: How do we visualize the results?
cues.zh: 如何視覺化結果？

cues.en: I mean, here we're visualizing the raw data, but we want to visualize the result of this logistic regression somehow.
cues.zh: 這裡畫的是原始資料，但想把邏輯斯迴歸結果視覺化。

cues.en: Now, with a regular regression, we can visualize it by plotting the original data, the raw data, and plotting the yhat,
cues.zh: 一般迴歸，可以畫原始資料，再疊上 yHat，

cues.en: the predicted data on top of that.
cues.zh: 也就是預測資料。

cues.en: So, but what we do here, because the model isn't actually outputting pass or fail, the model is outputting the probability of passing for each individual.
cues.zh: 但這裡，模型不直接輸出及格或不及格，而是每個人及格的機率。

cues.en: So here's how we can visualize those data.
cues.zh: 可以這樣視覺化。

cues.en: We have the individuals here on the X axis.
cues.zh: X 軸是個體。

cues.en: So there's 20 people in our research study.
cues.zh: 研究有 20 個人。

cues.en: And I've grouped them into failing and passing students.
cues.zh: 分成不及格與及格學生。

cues.en: So the first 10 here are all students who failed, and the next 10 here are all students who passed.
cues.zh: 前 10 位全是不及格，後 10 位全是及格。

cues.en: And then what I'm plotting here on the Y axis is the actual output of the logistic regression model.
cues.zh: Y 軸畫的是邏輯斯迴歸模型的實際輸出。

cues.en: So the logistic regression model is outputting a probability value for each individual, and it's the probability that that individual passed the exam.
cues.zh: 每個人都有一個機率值，就是該學生及格的機率。

cues.en: So what you see in this lower quadrant here would be concordances.
cues.zh: 左下象限這些，是一致的結果。

cues.en: This would be concordances, and these are inaccuracies.
cues.zh: 這裡也一致，這些則不準確。

cues.en: So we threshold the probabilities at 0.5, and we say when the probability is less than 0.5, we're gonna say that the model predicts
cues.zh: 以 0.5 作機率門檻，小於 0.5，就說模型預測

cues.en: that the student will fail.
cues.zh: 學生不及格。

cues.en: And when the model gives a probability value above 0.5, then we say the model predicts that the student will pass.
cues.zh: 機率大於 0.5，則預測學生及格。

cues.en: So it turns out that there are 15 values that are correctly predicted by the model, and there's five incorrect predictions.
cues.zh: 結果有 15 個模型預測正確，5 個錯誤。

cues.en: So two cases here where the model predicted that the student would pass, but he actually failed.
cues.zh: 兩例預測及格，實際卻不及格。

cues.en: And three cases here where the model predicted that the student would fail, but they actually passed.
cues.zh: 三例預測不及格，實際卻及格。

cues.en: So 15 out of 20 is 75%.
So we would say that this model has a 75% accuracy.
cues.zh: 因此模型準確率為 75%。

cues.en: So this framework is called predictive modeling, where you're using a logistic regression and your thresholding at 0.5 or probably 0.5,
cues.zh: 這個架構稱為預測建模，使用邏輯斯迴歸，以 0.5 或大概 0.5 作門檻，

cues.en: which would be the threshold value to use for binary outcomes.
cues.zh: 它是二元結果會使用的門檻值。

cues.en: And then we count the accuracy.
cues.zh: 接著計算準確率。

cues.en: So in this case, we get a model accuracy of 75%.
cues.zh: 這裡模型準確率為 75%。

cues.en: All right, so in this video I showed you how to think about logistic regression, how to solve for logistic regression, and I showed you an example of a logistic regression
cues.zh: 這支影片示範如何思考與求解邏輯斯迴歸，也舉了一個邏輯斯迴歸

cues.en: used in practice to predict whether students will pass or fail.
cues.zh: 實際預測學生及格或不及格的例子。
